checks.check: Direct calls return frozen canonical absolute runtime paths only for the exact verified identity; tampered files/metadata, extra files, bad target/baseline, links and unsafe roots fail closed.
checks.evidence: runtime-store.ts verifies canonical identity, ownership, non-link paths, exact membership, modes and content before freezing returned paths and identity. runtime-store.test.ts exercises valid resolution and restored negative cases; daemon reports passing.

checks.check: A self-consistent rewritten receipt/inventory cannot replace the independently pinned expected inventory hash.
checks.evidence: Completion bytes are compared with independently derived policy metadata; verifyRuntimeInventory compares the inventory digest with runtimeProfile.inventorySha256. Tests forge both receipt and inventory, then inventory alone, asserting exact failures and successful restoration.

checks.check: Resolver imports no application paths/DB/provider/source builder and performs no network, mkdir, controller lock, selection or application/Ollama traversal.
checks.evidence: Inspected resolver dependencies remain installer-only read primitives. The import-graph test checks bundled inputs; runtime tests trap mutation/download operations and constrain opened files and directory traversal to the runtime.

checks.check: Task-local fixtures prove this API; production consumer wiring is assessed in t8, not required prematurely for t2 validation.
checks.evidence: Resolver tests create isolated exact-profile fixtures and call privateRuntimePaths/verifyRuntimeEntry directly. Task commits change no production consumers.

checks.check: Default canonical resolution accepts only exact published root/directories0500, metadata0400, files pinnedmode&~0222 with zero write bits and exact execute intent. Source-stage checks original modes; permission-transition accepts only root0700/0500 with every descendant protected. No arbitrary mixed subtree or old-home adoption, allocation or launch paths from a weak verifier flag.
checks.evidence: Explicit lane checks enforce these exact POSIX modes. resolveRuntimeStore always verifies published protection; weaker lanes only select rejection diagnostics. Tests cover write/execute drift, source-stage, root-only transition, mixed descendants and ignored weaker resolver options.

checks.check: Use the exact LLD8 §4.3 runtime-invalid manual recovery, root-only unfinished and unsupported-development-layout messages. Manual text advises safely quoted root-only chmod, preservation/move and delete nothing, and explicitly disclaims product locking/all-consumer proof. Test spaces/Unicode/apostrophes and preservation; do not implement an operator move/recovery command.
checks.evidence: All three implementation messages match LLD.md §4.3. Tests compare complete messages, preserve corrupt bytes/root identity, and validate the quoted Unicode/apostrophe path through /bin/sh argument parsing. No recovery command was added.

checks.check: For every rejection mutation, establish a positive baseline beforehand, assert its precise expected code/message and prove restoration succeeds; no bare rejects or shared broken fixture false positives. Protected-fixture mutation helpers may deliberately alter only their captured isolated homes.
checks.evidence: rejectedMutation resolves successfully before mutation, checks runtime-invalid and the complete expected diagnostic, restores in finally and resolves again. Additional identity, lane, cancellation and diagnostic cases establish valid baselines and restoration. Mutation helpers capture the isolated home and constrain paths.

checks.check: Implement the proposed shared _owned-runtime-home.ts test helper using captured mkdtemp dev/inode/UID, retained child/resource closure and bounded nofollow checks. Restore directory ownerwrite only within that root after positive closure; never follow a link to chmod its target, mutate SDK/global/blocked roots or erase uncertain evidence. All adopting callers await cleanup, including allocation failure/after/finally. Prove cleanup/retention/refusal cases independently.
checks.evidence: The helper captures root identity, confirms retained child/resource closure, preflights a bounded lstat tree, and restores directory write through nofollow directory handles. Unknown links, replacement roots, failed/unconfirmed resources and excessive depth retain evidence. Eight daemon-passed tests independently exercise cleanup and refusal; resolver allocation failures and finalizers await cleanup.

checks.check: Introduce the owned-home helper without turning raw/shared mutable SDK caches into cleanup targets. Resolver fixtures can seed the strict protected form independently before T4 is implemented; fixture APIs with asynchronous disposal are awaited by every changed caller.
checks.evidence: The helper only creates its own mkdtemp root and cannot adopt caller paths. Resolver fixtures copy independently pinned source content into owned homes and seed protected modes locally. Shared source/archive caches are not passed to the helper; every changed resolver fixture caller awaits disposal.

verdict.reason: Task changes are confined to the resolver, owned-home helper, task-local tests and workflow evidence; all acceptance checks are supported by inspected code and daemon-passed tests/typecheck.
